overview: My company is under 'Company' in the left menu (company administrators). Its heading is 'My company'. It manages company information, branding and functional settings, with a 'Save changes' button. It has tabs: Company profile (name, phone, city, address), Corporate design (branding), Functional settings, and Language and regionalization. A side panel shows read-only Technical information such as the Company ID and plan. The Tags page is the sibling entry under Company.

screenshots.alt: The My company settings page in the MCL web platform
screenshots.description: The MCL web 'My company' page: a company profile header, tabs Company profile, Corporate design, Functional settings and Language and regionalization, a General information form, a read-only Technical information panel with Company ID and plan, and a Save changes button.
